title: GridSim v2 network file (gridsim-network/2)
description: One network file of a v2 case: the placed elements (buses, generators, demands, lines, transformers, on-load tap changers, boundaries, protective devices). A case lists one or more network files and the network is their union. The element shapes are the v1 shapes (src/GridSim.Core/IO/Json/JsonDtos.cs and ProtectionDto.cs, member names as the bundled data spells them) with these differences: one file holds every element array instead of one file per array; demand.json becomes 'demands', transmission.json 'lines', onloadtapchanger.json 'oltcs'; v1 'dynamicsClass' (generator, line, transformer) and protection 'class' become 'template', a pinned template reference id@rev; the generator's converterInterfaced, converterFaultCurrentPu and gridForming move into a 'converter' block; the line's rPu0 and xPu0 are spelt r0Pu and x0Pu. New v2-only members (not carried by v1): generator subtransientXdPu, negativeSeqXPu (generator inService is carried by v1 too since F16); line type, inService; transformer type, r0Pu, x0Pu, windings, neutralXPu, inService. The loader puts the sequence members (subtransientXdPu, negativeSeqXPu, r0Pu, x0Pu, windings, neutralXPu) into the model, where the fault studies read them; a line or transformer with inService false is refused by the loader for now. ABSENCE RULE: an optional member that is absent takes exactly the v1 default (JsonDtos.cs, JsonDefaults), so a v1 case and its v2 projection describe the same network. Values on network elements are bare numbers (no {v, unit, prov} object form). Member names are case-sensitive and unknown members are refused everywhere. Rules this schema subset cannot express (unique names and ids, every bus reference resolving, a referenced template existing and being of the right kind, ZIP triples summing to 1) are the loader's job (V2CaseLoader, N065) and are not checked here.

name.title: Element name
name.description: A name holding at least one non-blank character. Names are how boundaries, tap changers and (later) overrides address an element.

busId.title: Bus id
busId.description: A bus number, as in v1 buses.json.

zip.title: ZIP load model
zip.description: Voltage-dependent load at the bus (v1 BusZipDto): P(V) = Pd (ap V^2 + bp V + cp), Q(V) = Qd (aq V^2 + bq V + cq). All six coefficients are required, as the v1 loader requires; the rule that each triple sums to 1 is checked by the loader (JsonGridLoader.ParseZip), not here. Absent = constant power.

bus.title: Bus
bus.description: A bus (v1 BusDto). baseKv is required (N065, JSON v2 Phase 2): it has no default, as in the v1 loader since October 2026 (R179), because a silent 400 kV default scaled every kA figure of a fault study. Absent: type pq, vm 1, vaDeg/gs/bs/x/y 0, no name, no zip. v2 accepts only the three canonical type names; the v1 loader also takes aliases (ref, swing, gen) and, since October 2026 (N096), refuses any other word.

vminPu.description: This bus's own lower voltage limit, pu (v1 vminPu, F17). Absent = the global band. Used only by checks asked for per-bus limits.

vmaxPu.description: This bus's own upper voltage limit, pu (v1 vmaxPu, F17). Absent = the global band.

converter.title: Converter block
converter.description: The power-electronic interface of a generator (v1 converterInterfaced, converterFaultCurrentPu, gridForming). Absent block: interfaced inferred from the generator type, the default fault-current multiple, grid-following. Inside the block, an absent member takes the same default.

interfaced.description: Full-converter plant (fault current limited). Absent = inferred from the generator type.

faultCurrentPu.description: Converter fault current k, multiples of rated current; 0 = none (LCC HVDC). Absent = Generator.DefaultConverterFaultCurrentPu.

gridForming.description: Grid-forming (virtual synchronous machine) control. Absent = false.

generator.title: Generator
generator.description: A generating unit (v1 GenDto). Absent: type ccgt, capacityMva 0, outputMw from capacityMva x capacityFactor (capacityFactor from the type), voltageSetpoint 1, qMinMvar/qMaxMvar -/+ capacityMva, inertiaH 0, role pv, powerFlowOnly false, unitTransformerXPu 0, no template, no converter block, in service. unitTransformerXPu (the step-up transformer reactance on the unit rating) stays at generator level, not in the converter block: in gb-full it is carried by synchronous plant (nuclear, gas, hydro and others), where it is added to the machine reactance (SubtransientInit, Generator.FaultSourceReactancePu). v2-only: subtransientXdPu and negativeSeqXPu (on the unit rating; absent = the synthesised default). inService is carried by v1 too since F16 (October 2026): false = kept in the case but never solved.

type.description: Technology (hydro, nuclear, wind-onshore, interconnector, ...): drives the default capacity factor and the asset binding rules. The empty string means no technology given (a converted MATPOWER unit; the same rule as v1, October 2026 with N101).

template.description: The asset template bound to this unit (v1 dynamicsClass); wins over a case binding rule.

qMinMvar.description: Lower reactive limit, MVAr. A number, or the string "-Infinity" for no lower limit (N101: the same rule as v1).

qMaxMvar.description: Upper reactive limit, MVAr. A number, or the string "Infinity" for no upper limit (N101: the same rule as v1).

powerFlowOnly.description: A power-flow device (slack balancer, voltage-control unit), not physical plant.

subtransientXdPu.description: Subtransient reactance X''d, per unit on the unit rating (P5, N234: reaches Generator.SubtransientXdPu). Absent = the fault studies' synthesised 0.20 pu. Refused on a converter-interfaced unit.

negativeSeqXPu.description: Negative-sequence reactance X2, per unit on the unit rating (P5, N234: reaches Generator.NegativeSeqXPu). Absent = X''d. Refused on a converter-interfaced unit.

pMinMw.description: Minimum real output, MW (v1 pMinMw, F24). Absent = 0.

pMaxMw.description: Maximum real output, MW (v1 pMaxMw, F24). Absent = capacityMva. A number, or the string "Infinity" for no upper limit (N101: the same rule as v1).

qOutputMvar.description: Scheduled reactive output, MVAr (v1 qOutputMvar, F24). Absent = 0.

demand.title: Demand
demand.description: A demand (v1 DemandDto). Absent: qMvar from pMw and powerFactor, powerFactor 0.97 lagging. v2 refuses a power factor outside (0, 1]; the v1 loader clamped it to [0.01, 1].

line.title: Line
line.description: A line or cable (v1 LineDto). r/x/b are per unit on the case base for ONE circuit; circuits identical circuits run in parallel. Absent: bPu 0, ratingMva 0 (unrated), circuits 1, lengthKm 0 (unknown), no equipment, r0Pu/x0Pu 0 (not supplied: the studies assume a multiple of the positive sequence), no template, in service. v2-only: type (a lineType template), inService.

type.description: The line type (conductor or cable) template.

template.description: The passive-plant dynamics template bound to this line (v1 dynamicsClass); wins over a case binding rule.

r0Pu.description: Zero-sequence series resistance, per unit on the case base (v1 rPu0).

x0Pu.description: Zero-sequence series reactance, per unit on the case base (v1 xPu0).

tapRatio.description: Off-nominal turns ratio (v1 tapRatio, F24: a converted MATPOWER transformer kept in branch order). Absent = 1.

phaseShiftDeg.description: Phase shift, degrees (v1 phaseShiftDeg, F24). Absent = 0.

isTransformer.description: The branch is a transformer (v1 isTransformer, F24). Absent = false.

ratingBMva.description: Short-term rating B of one circuit, MVA (v1 ratingBMva, MATPOWER RATE_B, F20). Absent = 0 (not given).

ratingCMva.description: Emergency rating C of one circuit, MVA (v1 ratingCMva, MATPOWER RATE_C, F20). Absent = 0 (not given).

windingConnection.title: Winding connection
windingConnection.description: Exactly the member names of GridSim.Core.Model.WindingConnection (pinned by a test).

transformer.title: Transformer
transformer.description: A two-winding transformer (v1 TransformerDto). Absent: tapRatio 1, phaseShiftDeg 0, ratingMva 0 (unrated), no template, in service. v2-only (the shapes of GridModel's Branch zero-sequence fields): type (a transformerType template), r0Pu and x0Pu (zero-sequence series impedance, per unit on the case base), windings (the from- and to-side connections), neutralXPu (from- and to-side neutral earthing reactance, per unit), inService.

template.description: The passive-plant dynamics template bound to this transformer (v1 dynamicsClass); wins over a case binding rule.

ratingBMva.description: Short-term rating B, MVA (v1 ratingBMva, MATPOWER RATE_B, N119). Absent = 0 (not given).

ratingCMva.description: Emergency rating C, MVA (v1 ratingCMva, MATPOWER RATE_C, N119). Absent = 0 (not given).

r0Pu.description: Zero-sequence leakage resistance, per unit on the case base (P5, N234: reaches Branch.R0). Needs x0Pu and windings.

x0Pu.description: Zero-sequence leakage reactance, per unit on the case base (P5, N234: reaches Branch.X0). Needs windings. Absent = Z0 taken equal to Z1.

windings.description: The from- and to-side winding connections (P5, N234: reach Branch.FromWinding / ToWinding). They decide the transformer's zero-sequence path; without them the fault studies have no earthed neutral from this unit.

neutralXPu.description: Neutral earthing reactance of each side, per unit on the case base (P5, N234: reach Branch.FromNeutralXPu / ToNeutralXPu). Only on a WyeGrounded side; needs windings.

oltc.title: On-load tap changer
oltc.description: An on-load tap changer (v1 OltcDto) on the named transformer. Absent: targetVpu 1, minTap 0.9, maxTap 1.1, stepPu 0.0125, deadbandPu 0.01.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: A transfer boundary (v1 BoundaryDto): the named branches whose signed flows sum to the boundary flow. Absent branches = none; a branch's absent direction = 1.

protection.title: Protective device
protection.description: A placed protective device (v1 ProtectionInstanceDto). template replaces v1 'class' and names a template of kind protection. Absent: capacityMw 0, no target branch.
